g.text: Reason: Large build contexts slow every build and risk leaking secrets.
Reason: Containers default to root when the final stage omits USER.
Reason: JDK images are typically 100–300 MB larger than JRE equivalents.
Reason: Debug tooling is useful during incidents but rarely belongs in
Reason: Shell ENTRYPOINT spawns an extra shell process and breaks signal
Reason: Without HEALTHCHECK, failed services may keep receiving traffic.
All estimates are heuristic in Milestone 1.
